Commentary.Commentary: There are still 9 overs to go in the day and if at all they can manage to pick up a wicket or two, you never know they can drag the momentum back towards them. Stay tuned as the second innings is about to get underway...

If not for the experienced duo of Shakib and Tamim, the hosts would have been bowled out pretty early than this. The experienced pair guided their side through the turbulent tides by stitching a vital 155-run stand. Both missed out on their centuries but have done the job their side was hoping for.

After two competitive sessions in the day, Bangladesh have crumbled as they lost the plot towards the end. Losing last 4 wickets for just 20 runs would have given the upper hand to the Aussies. After Pat Cummins set the tone for them early this morning, the spin duo did the cleaning work towards the end and have managed to restrict the hosts from reaching the 300-run mark.

OUT! BANGLADESH ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 260! Ashton Agar serves a loopy ball outside off, Islam clears his front leg to go big down the ground but ends up mistiming it high in the air towards mid on. Hazlewood stationed there, nicely gets underneath it and takes the catch to perfection.
Flat and quick outside off, Islam gets an outside edge as he looks to defend. The ball rolls towards point.
Shorter in length outside off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! That's clumsy effort from Cummins! Agar drops it short and wide outside off, Islam's eyes light up as he slaps it towards backward point. Cummins is lazy to stop it as the ball races away to the fence. This will hurt the Aussies.
FOUR! Swings and gets the result! Tossed up delivery around middle, Islam swings hard across the line and dumps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Turning away from outside off, Rahman hangs his bat out in defense only to get beaten.

OUT! Wicket number 250 for Nathan Lyon in Tests! He comes from around the wicket and sends in a quicker full ball around middle and off, Islam prods forward to defend but misses and is hit on the back pad. Lyon turns back to appeal and sees the umpire's finger going up. He is down on one knee and celebrates.

OUT! It's pad first! The on-field call has to be overturned! What a review from the Aussies. Agar drifts it around off, it skids on as Hossain lunges forward to defend it by keeping his bat and pad together. Ashton Agar is confident and appeals long and hard for it. Umpire Nigel Llong shakes his head. Agar feels it's pad first and hence convinces his skipper to take the review. Ultra Edge confirms it is pad first and then the bat. After that, the Ball Tracker shows three reds. That's it for Hossain as he continues to walk back.
Australia have referred an LBW appeal against Nasir Hossain. Is it bat or pad first?

Islam lunges forward and defends it neatly.

OUT! Lyon goes past Richie Benaud in terms of wickets! That's a special feat. Spinning back into the pads from outside off, Mehedi Hasan gets forward to defend it. The ball was nowhere close to the bat and the Ultra Edge proved that. Hasan can only blame his fellow teammates for wasting the reviews. Can Australia restrict Bangladesh under 300?

Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.

Update 1605 local time - We have great news for you guys. The rain has stopped and the covers are being taken off. Match set to resume at 1615 local time.

And as expected! The rain is coming down heavily which has forced the players to walk off the field. The current scenario is such that even if the rain stops, bad light could then be the issue as it's too murky out there. Let's hope for the best. Stay with us as we will keep you posted...

Pat Cummins is back into the attack. The floodlights are on as well and the dark clouds can burst out any moment it seems...

Ball Tracker shows that it pitched in line, impact was also in line and it was going on to hit the stumps. Agar strikes and Bangladesh have lost their last recognized batsman.

Welcome back for the final session. Mushfiqur Rahim will take strike against Ashton Agar.
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

The hosts will again have to start from scratch whereas the Aussies would be looking to keep chipping away at the wickets as they have gotten the opening they needed. Anything near to 300 will be a challenging total on this surface. Let's wait and see what the final session has in store. Join us shortly for that.

A session shared by both the teams but Bangladesh will be a bit happier of the two. Shakib and Iqbal started off really well and negotiated the first hour after lunch with comfort, scoring their respective fifties. But the drinks break turned the tide and Maxwell soon got into the act and dismissed Tamim. Lyon too joined the party later and got the back of Shakib who was looking really settled in the middle as he didn't allow the all-rounder to reach the three-figure mark.
Gives it a bit more air outside off, Hossain takes a good stride forward and blocks it out. TEA ON DAY 1!
Quicker one around middle and off, defended by covering the line.
Around middle and leg, worked towards the on side.
Short and spinning in, defended off the back foot.

Edged and away! On a back of a length and zipping off the surface, Rahim is taken by surprise as he looks to fend it away. The ball takes the outside part of the bat and runs past the slip cordon for a couple.
Nasir Hossain is the next man in!

OUT! No hundred for Shakib too! Nathan Lyon strikes at last! He drops it on a shorter length around off, it turns away with extra bounce. All this while Shakib Al Hasan was lucky to not nick it but this time he loses his patience. Gets an outside edge to it at first slip where Steven Smith takes the catch. He throws the ball upwards and is absolutely elated. Shakib walks back with a forlorn face. Lyon also equals Richie Benaud's tally of 248 wickets in Tests.
Around middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Gets a bit forward and defends.

Fuller outside off, pushed into the off side.

NOT OUT! Fuller and angling in on the pads, Rahim misses his clip and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal follows to which the umpire pays no interest. Cummins thinks about the review but then decides against it. Good call, as it was going down leg.
No ball! Fuller and angling in on middle, pushed towards mid off. It's called as a no ball as Cummins oversteps.
Fuller outside off, pushed off the front foot gently.
Fuller and angling in, bunted back to the bowler.

On a length and outside off, Rahim looks to poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Gets a bit forward and drives it towards mid off for a single. Warner at mid off seems to have hurt his leg there.
Wide! Cummins from around the wicket, bangs in short ball outside off, it kicks off the deck appreciably. Shakib just lets it sail over him to the keeper.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Goes on the back foot and cuts it through point for a single.

Two Byes! What turn and bounce! Spinning down leg with a bit more bounce as Rahim shoulders his arms. They run two byes.

Nathan Lyon is back into the attack.
Not that full, outside off, a punchy drive towards Warner at mid off.
Takes a stride forward and eases it through cover for a single.

Good shot and fielded well too! Fuller in length and outside off, Shakib shows the full face of the bat as he caresses it through mid off. Warner gives it a chase and does well to keep them down to two.
Leading edge... safe! Fuller and straightening a bit after pitching, Shakib looks to flick it away but closes the bat face early. The ball goes off the leading edge and falls safely towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
That spun! It was pitched outside off, it spun in with a good amount of bounce. Rahim rocks back to defend but then is undone by the spin. Somehow manages to keep it out.
Stays back footed and defends it down watchfully.
FOUR! Risky! Maxwell fires it full and outside off, Rahim gets down to play the reverse sweep and just manages to get it over the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Rahim comes forward to block it out.
Goes back and dabs it wide of the point fielder for a single.
Flat and skidding in a touch, Shakib goes back and punches it towards short extra cover.
Fuller and swinging in on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.

Inside edge! But Josh Hazlewood is getting the ball to reverse here. He pitches it on a length outside off, it curls back as Rahim has a push at it. Gets an inside edge on the pads which certainly saves him.
Back of a length delivery outside off, stabbed comfortably off the back foot.
Fuller and veering on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.

Almost drags it on! No luck for Hazlewood here. He's running in hard and creating chances. Let me tell you, he was the prime reason for the wicket to fall. In his previous over he troubled the batsman to an extent which ultimately led to Tamim's downfall. Now he drops it on a back of a length, Rahim tries to keep it out off the back foot but the ball catches the toe-end of the bat and just bounces over the stumps. Josh has his hands on his head.
Short and gripping in, pulled through mid-wicket by the Bangladeshi skipper to get off the mark.

Goes back to this quicker ball and defends it with a straight bat.
Skipper Mushfiqur Rahim strides out to the middle.

OUT! Glenn Maxwell gets the breakthrough. A much-needed one! He drops it a bit short around off, it turns away further with a bit of bounce. Tamim Iqbal goes back to cut but delays his shot a touch. Slices it uppishly towards backward point where David Warner takes a dolly. Rejoice for the Aussies. It is also Warner's 50th Test catch! Oh hold on! Tamim was waiting near the boundary rope as umpire wanted to check for the no ball. Replays roll in and it shows Maxwell's landing is fine. Now Tamim is given the marching order. The 155-run stand comes to an end.
A shout for an LBW again! Quicker through the air around middle and off, Iqbal comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge.
Lands it around middle, gets a bit of turn and bounce as Tamim defends it off the top half of the bat.

Another brilliant delivery! Yorker on leg, Shakib misses and wears it on the pads. A stifled appeal but it was going down leg. Hazlewood gives a stare to Shakib, maybe saying - "hey mate you are in for a contest".
Fuller on leg, nudged away towards the on side.

FOUR! Superb! There was a hint of reverse but Hazlewood sprayed it a bit too wide outside off. Shakib Al Hasan latches on to it as he drives it over a leaping Renshaw at short extra cover for a boundary.

What a delivery, that! Hazlewood fires in a perfect yorker at the bat of middle and leg. Tamim Iqbal is quick to get his bat down in time. The ball goes off the inside edge on the pads towards backward square leg and they run a single. Josh turns back and appeals long and hard but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show Tamim did manage to get a bit of wood on it.
A bit fuller outside off, Iqbal shoulders his arms to that one.

FOUR BYES! That's not impressive from Wade! Hazlewood lands it on a back of a length around off, it jags away a bit to square the opener up. The ball nearly takes the outside edge and Wade behind the stumps fails to collect it. The ball goes off his gloves and races down to the fence.

Time for Drinks! Another hour belonging to Bangladesh! They have been really fantastic with the bat and except a couple of hiccups, Shakib and Iqbal have looked really comfortable in the middle. Australia will need to break this partnership to impose some pressure on the opposition. A vital hour awaits.
Shakib stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
That was close! Shorter delivery around off, Iqbal goes for the cut. Gets it just past the diving Australian skipper at first slip for a couple. That was not a million miles away from Smith...
Iqbal gets behind the pitch of the ball to defend it.

FOUR! Another inside out played to perfection! Floats this outside off, Iqbal plays the inside out over the extra cover region for a boundary. He is playing it with some precision today as there were two fielders in the deep and he bisected them with ease.

Iqbal pushes at it off the back foot and it goes straight back to the bowler. Hazlewood, in his followthrough crouches low to his right to take it but fails to hold onto it. A tough chance goes down abegging and Tamim survives.

Length delivery around off, Iqbal gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Shakib clips it on the leg side for a single.
23rd Test fifty for Tamim Iqbal!

Shakib gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Shakib drives it towards the fielder at mid off.

100-run stand between Shakib Al Hasan and Tamim Iqbal! These two guys are batting out really well and now they have started counter attacking at a really good pace. Bangladesh are highly reliant on these two.
Angling into the hips, clipped through square leg for a single.
Around middle and leg, Shakib lunges forward and counters it.

Play and a miss! Back of a length delivery outside off, Iqbal flashes his blade but only manages to get beaten.

Good length delivery outside off, Shakib mistimes his punch towards the fielder at covers.
Shakib presses forward and drives it towards the fielder at covers.

It's Agar again! Seems like wherever he goes, the ball is going to follow. Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Tamim clips it towards the fielder at mid on where Ashton misfields and allows a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Shakib stands tall in his crease to defend it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller in line of the pads, Shakib gets his bat down in time to block it.
Tossed up this time, Shakib gets to the pitch of the ball to defend it.
Shorter around off, defended towards point.
FOUR! Poor fielding! Short around off, Shakib camps back and punches it towards the backward point region. Ashton Agar puts in a lazy effort and lets it through his legs for a boundary.
Floated outside off, Shakib is drawn into the stroke but misses his punch this time.
Length delivery outside off, Iqbal pushes it towards covers. A maiden from Josh Hazlewood to start with.
Good length delivery outside off, Tamim stays in his crease and defends it.
Dug in short in line of the batsman, Iqbal sways away from the line of the ball.
Length delivery outside off, Iqbal lunges forward and drives it towards covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Tamim stands tall and defends it well.
Floated outside off, played to the point region.
Quicker delivery around off, Shakib cuts it really late this time.

Confusion in the middle! Another shorter delivery around off, Shakib cuts it towards the fielder at backward point. Agar misfields there and Iqbal is interested in the single. He is halfway down the track when Shakib sends him back. The throw is at the non-striker's end but Tamim is well in.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter around off, cut towards the fielder at backward point for a single.
Floated fuller around off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Clipped through the mid-wicket region for a single.

Another edge which does not carry! Good length delivery outside off, Iqbal lunges forward and tries to defend it on the off side. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball falls short of Renshaw at first slip. The variable bounce helps the batsman this time around.
Tamim gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it neatly.
Good length delivery around off, Tamim stays tall and defends it neatly.
Fuller outside off this time, Tamim leans forward and drives it through covers for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Shakib gets forward and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
22nd Test fifty for Shakib Al Hasan.

Fifty! He is the world's number 1 all-rounder for a reason! Agar drops it short outside off, Shakib cuts it really fine past the slip region for a couple. This has been an exceptional knock and his contribution will be really vital here. Raises his bat there and the crowd acknowledges the cheers.
Quicker in line of the stumps, drives it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Shakib Al Hasan gets forward and defends it neatly.
Tossed up around off, Tamim lunges forward and drives it through the cover-point region for a single.
Floated around leg, Iqbal camps back and defends it in front of the fielder at short leg.

Welcome back for the post-lunch session. Australia will be hoping to start in a similar manner as in the morning, while the hosts will want the two batsmen out there in the middle to continue for as long as possible. Tamim Iqbal to face Ashton Agar first up. A slip and a short leg in place. Here we go...
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

The track is such that neither side can be counted out for the moment. The deck is spitting venom and batting will keep on getting tougher. Australia will not be too disappointed with the run rate and will concentrate more on bowling in the right areas. The spinners don't have any wickets to show but they have bowled well. With two left-handers batting, might not be a bad idea to just try out Maxwell for a bit. Join us back at 1240 local (0640 GMT) for the second session.

The highly consistent Tamim Iqbal, who was watching partners disappear within the blink of an eye, was joined by the number 1 all-rounder, Shakib Al Hasan. Both are playing their 50th Test and have not disappointed so far. Tamim has been more cautious of the two while Shakib has been flirting with danger, playing his shots. However, they have come off and the result is that the home side has recovered from a precarious position to one of stability with the current stand reading 86.

An entertaining session of cricket! It was Australia in the first hour, as they started the day in a tremendous manner. Cummins picked up three quick wickets, thanks to a couple of loose shots. At 10/3, it seemed like an age-old story with visitors coming in Bangladesh and putting them in trouble. But it was not to be.
Around middle and leg, wristed through square leg by leaning across. A single taken and that will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Gives it a bit more air around off, patted into the cover region.
Short and turning away, gives time to Tamim to go back deep in the crease and glide it past first slip. Two runs taken.
Floats it up outside off, eased down through mid off for a single.
Sends in quicker, lands it full on middle, blocked gently.

Edgyyy! Drops it on a shorter length outside off, Shakib goes back, gets squared up a bit. Gets an outside edge as the ball falls short of Smith at first slip. The key there was that he played with soft hands.
Tosses it up on off, defended by coming forward.
Darts it on a fuller length outside off, blocked into the ground.
Covers the line this time and blocks it under his nose.
Stays back to this flattish ball and tucks it around the corner for a single.
Goes back and works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air around middle, worked into the on side.
FOUR! Delightful! This time it's Shakib Al Hasan who joins in. Dances down the track and drives it neatly through covers to pick up a boundary. 11 runs off the over.
Fuller delivery into the pads, Iqbal fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and the ball goes towards square leg for a leg bye.
Flat and quick on off, dabbed with an open face bat.

SIX! How good a shot that is! On a turning pitch, Tamim Iqbal takes his chance. Skips down the track and lifts it inside out over extra cover. He stood there with the pose for a while and admires the shot himself. The crowd is right behind him.
Goes back and punches it towards the cover region.
Tossed up on off, defended by coming forward.
Change of ends for Nathan Lyon.

FOUR! Edged and away! More frustration for Agar. He sends in a flatter delivery outside off, Shakib winds up for a cut shot but gets an outside edge. The ball flies towards backward point and Wade shouts "Catch it". However, Lyon stationed there dives to his right but the ball was far away from his reach.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Gets forward and blocks it into the ground.

Fires it outside off, Iqbal looks to play the reverse sweep but it goes on the bounce to Smith who shows great reflexes to stop it by diving to his right at first slip. He also has a shy at the striker's end but misses.

Miles away from Smith! A bit flat and served outside off, Tamim crouches low and tries to dab it away. Gets it off the outer edge and goes wide of Smith at first slip who hunts it down. A brace added to the total.
Starts from over the wicket, tosses it up outside off. Tamim leans across and lets it be.
Here comes Ashton Agar. The last time he played a Test match was way back in 2013. A lot will be on him to deliver. A slip and a short leg in place...
Almost chops it on! On a back of a length outside off, Shakib is cramped for room as he looks to cut. Gets an inside edge on the pads.
Length delivery on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Fires it full and outside off, it's left alone without much fuss.
The breeze has picked up now and it is blowing thick and fast.
Short and angling in on the body, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
Slants it away outside off, tempting Shakib to go after it. He accepts the proposal as he goes chasing behind it. Is beaten all ends up.
Shortish around off, Iqbal opens the face of the bat and gets it past cover for a single.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Goes back and wrists it away towards the on side.

What a stop from Maxwell! Saved a certain boundary there. A bit flat and outside off, Shakib skips down the track and hits it towards extra cover where Maxwell stretches his left hand to stop that one. Lyon goes towards his fielder and pats him on the back.
A silly point comes in place for Shakib.
Darts it on the pads, Tamim has no time to flick it away. The ball goes off the pads and rolls away. They take a leg bye.
Lunges forward once again and counters this tossed up delivery.
Comes forward and then opens the face of the bat to glide it away.
Once again on a fuller length near the pads, worked away through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller on leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Shortish around off, it kicks off the deck as Shakib looks to defend. The extra bounce takes the handle of the bat and dies well in front of the gully fielder.

A shout for an LBW! Fuller and tries to bring this back into the batsman, Iqbal looks to flick it away but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards mid-wicket. The batsmen are busy crossing for a leg bye but Cummins keeps appealing for a leg before. Umpire Aleem Dar shows no interest as it was pitching outside leg.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Iqbal stands tall and meets it  with a straight blade.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, a bit quicker through the air, Shakib looks to sweep but misses. It wasn't far away from kissing the off pole.
FOUR! That's more like it! Tossed up outside off, Shakib takes his front foot out of the way and bashes it over mid-wicket. No one in the deep and he picks up a boundary to his name.
Gets forward and blocks it out.
A bit flat around off, the batsman thought it's short so stays back but this one doesn't bounce at all. Goes past the outside edge to Wade.

50-run stand between Tamim Iqbal and Shakib Al Hasan! These two veterans have done a really good job of building a partnership after the initial stutter. They will need to carry on if Bangladesh hope to reach a competitive score.

In the air... safe! Lyon floats it up outside off, Shakib kneels down to bring out the sweep but gets a top edge instead. The ball goes high in the air but lands safely near the fine leg region. The fielder was there in the deep but was a bit squarer. They take a couple. Surely Shakib's heart would have been in his mouth when the ball lobbed up in the air.
Leans forward a touch and pushes it off the front foot towards mid off.
This one didn't bounce! Cummins hits the deck hard, Iqbal crouches low to let it sail. It does go over the batsman but bounces twice before reaching Wade.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Fuller on off, worked towards mid on.
Short of a length delivery on leg, Shakib Al Hasan is taken aback by it. He fends it away awkwardly through the vacant short leg region and gets to the other end.
Fuller ball from over the wicket, it's on the leg stump line as the all-rounder clips it away uppishly through mid-wicket to collect a brace.
Pat Cummins is back on for another spell.
Once again leans ahead and buries it into the ground.
Flat and quick outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Takes a stride forward and nudges it towards the leg side.
Pushes it quicker through the air outside off, Tamim takes his front pad across and then leaves it alone. A good take from Wade behind.
Darts in a fuller ball around middle and off, defended by lunging forward.
Floats it up outside off, Shakib comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls past first slip for a single.
Slants it away on a length outside off, dabbed towards gully.
Fuller and curling back in a bit, defended by coming forward.
Short and on middle and leg, pulled along the ground through mid-wicket for one.
On a good length outside off, punched towards the fielder at mid off.

FOUR! Just over the gully fielder! Hazlewood hurls it on a shorter length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to slap it through the off side. Flays it over a leaping Handscomb at gully to find a streaky boundary.
Veers on the pads does Josh, it's clipped through mid-wicket for a comfortable double.
Tossed up outside off, patted into the cover region. "Noyseeee Garry" says Wade behind the stumps.
Beaten again! Loops it up outside off, Tamim lunges forward to block but the ball turns away to beat the outside edge.
Around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.

This time Shakib gets down on one knee and brooms it fine down the leg side. Hazlewood in the deep comes running to his left and does well to crouch low to stop the ball from crossing the rope. Three runs picked up.
Almost! That was so close! Lyon can't believe it. He tosses it up around off, it turns away with extra bounce to nearly take the outside edge. Not easy to bat when the ball is doing so much.
Lands it around off, it turns away as Shakib punches it towards silly point.
Slants it away on a back of a length outside off, pushed with soft hands towards cover.
Bangs in a short ball around leg, TI ducks to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Sprays it a touch wide outside off to make Tamim play at it.
Tamim tries to take Hazlewood off his length. On a back of a length on middle, Iqbal comes down the track but is cramped for room. Ends up defending it besides the wicket.
Good ball! Angles it away outside off, Tamim lunges forward to defend but misses as the ball whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
On a shorter length and outside off, Shakib has a push inside the line but gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce to Handscomb at gully who half-stops it. A single is taken.
Darts it around middle and leg, Shakib gets forward to counter it but the ball takes the inside edge and rolls away towards mid-wicket for a single.
A bit slower through the air around off, Shakib mistimes his cut towards point.
Gully moves out and a silly point comes in...
Loops it up outside off, defended by prodding forward.
A bit flat and short outside off, cut away towards point.
Lands it around middle and off, defended by getting right behind it.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot towards short extra cover.

Time for Drinks! Australia started really well with the ball where Cummins bowled exceptionally well to pick up a 3-fer. Since then, Shakib and Iqbal have managed to steady the ship but a long, long session awaits in front of them.
Good length delivery outside off, Iqbal shoulders his arms to it. Third maiden in a row for Australia!
Comes around the wicket this time, bowls this on a length outside off. Tamim stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at gully.
Short delivery down the leg side, TI sits under the bouncer.
Length delivery outside off, Tamim lunges forward to defend.
Short of a good length outside off, Iqbal pushes it towards the fielder at gully.
Back of a length delivery around off, Iqbal stays tall and defends it on the off side.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away. Shakib Al Hasan fails to make contact this time.
Floated around off, Shakib gets forward and defends it.
Fires this around leg, Shakib clips it towards mid-wicket.
Short this time, generates bounce like a pace bowler does. Shakib fails to punch it on the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flaoted around middle and off, Shakib gets forward and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone by Iqbal this time.
Length delivery around off, Iqbal gets forward and drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery around off, Tamim lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Fuller delivery outside off, Tamim throws his bat on that one. Misses it completely and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Tamim shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery around off, Iqbal gets forward to defend it.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated around off, spinning away. Shakib tries to defend it but gets beaten there.
Shakib prods forward and defends it.
Floated around off, Shakib gets forward to defend. Ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Driven through mid off for a single.
Floats this one around off, Shakib pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Good shot! Good length delivery outside off, Shakib slaps it over the point region for a boundary.

Falls short! Good length delivery around middle, Shakib Al Hasan gets behind it and tries to defend it. Gets hit on the handle and then the gloves. The ball, however, falls short of the fielder at first slip.
Good length delivery into the hips, flicked through square leg for a single.
Hurls this fuller around leg, clipped towards mid on. The fielder misfields there and allows the batsmen a single.
Fuller around off, Shakib drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Shakib gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Pushed quicker in line of the pads, Iqbal stays in his crease and tries to defend. Gets the faintest of edge on it and the ball runs through towards fine leg for a couple.
Tamim gets forward and defends it.
That's spitting venom! Outside off, the ball spins away and kicks off voraciously this time. Tamim is able to leave it.
Tamim gets forward and blocks it neatly.
Spins sharp and square! Tosses this one around middle, Iqbal tries to defend it off the front foot. Gets beaten by the away spin and the bounce.
Floated in line of the stumps, Iqbal dances down the track and blocks it away.
Length delivery around off, defended neatly by the batsman.
FOUR! Edged! Good length delivery outside off, Shakib tries to push it on the up. Gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball goes over the slip cordon for a boundary. Lucky runs this.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Good length delivery around off, angling away. Tamim shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length delivery around off, Iqbal stays tall in his crease to defend it.
Good length delivery into the hips, clipped through square leg for a single.

SIX! Boom! That came from nowhere! Tosses this one outside off, Iqbal dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the extra cover region. No need to run for this as the ball sails over the fence for a maximum.
Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Around leg this time, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tamim gets forward and defends it.
Four byes! Sprayed down the leg side, does not spin at all. Iqbal fails to clip it through and the keeper misses it too. The ball races away to the fence.
Starts with a fuller delivery around off, Tamim gets forward and defends it.
Spin introduced into the attack so early. Seems like Australia have a plan in mind. Nathan Lyon to bowl now.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Shakib lets it through to the keeper.
Short delivery down the leg side, Shakib ducks underneath it.
Back of a length delivery around off, Shakib Al Hasan dabs it towards covers. Thinks of a single but Iqbal sends him back.
FOUR! Shot! Good length delivery outside off, Shakib stays in his crease and punches it through the backward point region. The veteran looks in a good knick today.
Length around middle and leg, clipped towards the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery around off, Shakib Al Hasan gets in line of the ball to defend the hat-trick ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Iqbal gets in line of the stumps to defend it.
FOUR! Short delivery from Hazlewood, Iqbal stands tall and goes for the pull. Gets it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Iqbal stays in his crease and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, Tamim lets it through to the keeper.
Dug in short, Iqbal ducks under it.
Number 1 all-rounder in the world, Shakib Al Hasan walks out to the middle.

OUT! Golden duck for Rahman! The on-field decision stands! Cummins hurls a fuller delivery around off, Sabbir Rahman tries to get his bat down in time to dig it out but gets beaten for pace. Ends up getting an outside edge to it and the ball again flies to the keeper. Wade accepts it gleefully this time by getting a bit low. Sabbir is quick to opt for the review as he is confident that he did not hit it. Ultra Edge shows that there was bat involved and the batsman will have to walk back. Cummins has totally bamboozled the Bangladesh top order here. He will be on a hat-trick in the next over.
What's going on? Sabbir Rahman is given out caught behind. He takes the review as he thinks the sound is of the bat hitting the ground. Is it? Let's wait and see what Ultra Edge detects...
Sabbir Rahman walks in next, replacing Kayes.

OUT! Woah, that's a waste of a wicket! Good length delivery outside off, Kayes stays in his crease and goes for a sheepish punch. Is a bit early into the shot and ends up getting an inside edge which carries straight to the keeper. Imrul did not need to play that. Wade is not dropping those and Cummins gets his second. Australia are having a gala time out there in the middle.
Short delivery from Cummins this time around leg, Kayes ducks under it and lets it through to the keeper.
Length delivery around off, Kayes gets forward and defends it towards the mid off region.
Kayes gets in line of the ball to defend it neatly.
That might hurt! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Kayes fails to fend it away. Gets hit on the body there.
Good length delivery, kicks off the deck. Iqbal gets a bit forward and hangs his bat in the air to defend. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and goes through to the keeper.
Length outside off, Iqbal leans forward and gets his bat down in time to defend it.
Good length delivery outside off, Iqbal shuffles across the line and lets it through to the keeper.
Length delivery in line of the stumps, Tamim prods forward and defends it.
Good length delivery around off, Tamim stays in his crease and blocks it on the off side.
Fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal gets forward and defends it neatly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kayes stays tall and defends it on the off side. That's a really good over from Cummins!
Imrul Kayes is the next man in.

OUT! Cummins strikes early! This so seemed coming! Good length delivery around off, Sarkar tries to push it on the up. Is squared up and ends up getting a thick outside edge on it. The ball flies straight towards the fielder at gully. Handscomb gets a tad low and takes a fine catch to his right. Pat has drawn first blood of the encounter and Australia have got the perfect start to the day.
Short and a bit wide this time, Sarkar flashes his blade at it but fails to make contact.

FOUR! Narrow escape! Short delivery around off, Soumya stays back and tries to defend it. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies just over the third slip fielder for a boundary. Cummins has started really well here.
Back of a length delivery, nipping away. Sarkar shoulders his arms to it.

Chance there! Short of a length delivery around off, Iqbal taps it towards covers and calls for a quick single. Lyon races to the ball and fires a throw at the non-striker's end. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Pat Cummins to share the new ball with Josh Hazlewood.
FOUR! First boundary of the day! Short and wide outside off, Sarkar stays tall to it and crashes the cut through the point region for a boundary. Soumya gets off the mark with it.
Angling down the leg side this time around, Soumya fails to clip it through.
Length delivery around off, Sarkar stays in his crease and defends it.
Very full this time by Hazlewood, Soumya Sarkar adjusts and blocks it neatly.
Hurls a fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Iqbal clips it through the backward square leg region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off to start with, nipping away. Iqbal lets it through to the keeper.

The players are making their way out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar will open the batting for Bangladesh. Meanwhile, Josh Hazlewood to start the proceedings with the first new ball. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Steven Smith says that he would have batted first as well as the wicket looks dry and slow. Mentions that they have trained really well. Adds that it has been a while since they last played a Test match. Informs that they are going in with three spinners.

Mushfiqur Rahim says that he will bat first. Reckons that the wicket looks good so they will look to optimize in the first couple of days. Also mentions that they beat England here so they are confident to face the Aussies.

Pitch Report - Ed Rainsford doing the pitch report says that still after so much rain in Dhaka, the pitch looks dry. Reckons that the wicket will deteriorate quickly but it will be good for batting initially.
TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT! It is the 50th Test for the Bangladesh veterans - Shakib Al Hasan and Tamim Iqbal.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage for the first Test between Bangladesh and Australia at Mirpur. This has been a much-awaited contest and it is finally taking place. Australia, who are short of match practice will hope to start the series on a high. Bangladesh on the other hand will look to make things difficult for the visitors as the pitch is expected to turn square from the start itself. Rain is a big concern here and we hope it stays away. Stay tuned for the toss.
